title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.
At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.
 Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system.
You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

title: Senior Product Owner – CRM (m/f/d)
description:
Your Contribution As Senior Product Owner – CRM, you drive the evolution of our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms and ensure they continuously support our business objectives. You combine product ownership with a strong focus on business process excellence, challenging existing ways of working and identifying opportunities for simplification and automation. Acting as the bridge between business and technology, you align stakeholders across functions and countries around a shared product vision. Through continuous improvement of customer, operational, and financial processes, you help create better customer experiences, higher efficiency, and scalable business operations.
 Menu of Responsibilities In this role, you take ownership of our CRM and ERP landscape and drive continuous improvement across business-critical processes:
 Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms, aligned with business strategy and customer experience goals. Analyse , challenge, and continuously improve end-to-end business processes across Order-to-Cash, billing, payments, customer management,  logistics , procurement, and finance. Own and  prioritise  the product backlog, translating business needs and process improvement opportunities into clear user stories and deliverables. Partner with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Support, Operations, Logistics, and Data teams to align priorities and  maximise  business value. Lead collaboration with implementation and service partners, ensuring solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and expected outcomes. Drive adoption of new capabilities by ensuring process integrity, data quality, effective release planning, stakeholder engagement, and continuous feedback.
